title: 9th International Ancient Arts Festival Kicks Off in New Delhi: Schedule and Highlights
description: The 9th International Ancient Arts Festival (IAAF) was inaugurated in New Delhi on November 25, 2026, with prominent Indian classical dancers, musicians, and other international artistes participating in the festival for two days. The festival is being organized by the Rays of Wisdom Society of Delhi and will continue till November 26, 2026. The festival has been organized with the objective of celebrating the artistic and philosophical tradition of India through classical dances, music, and international cultural collaboration. The highlights of the festival include Odissi, Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, Kathak, Russian folk dance, and Hindustani classical music. Kathak Meets Russian Folk Dance […]

title: How the construction, desecration and destruction of Jerusalem's ancient temples shaped Judaism
description: In 167 B.C.E., on the 25th day of the Hebrew month of Kislev, the Greek king Antiochos IV Epiphanes entered the Jewish Temple in Jerusalem. According to tradition, he converted the sanctuary to a temple to Zeus.
